subject: Dedicated capacity demo & throughput verification — DataQuarry (self-signup + SDR intake)
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@dataquarry.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: samir.shah@dataquarry.ai
Date: 2028-11-01T14:03:00-08:00
Subject: Self-signup details + Dedicated capacity ask

Hi Laura,

I signed up through the self-serve flow this morning (DataQuarry). We ran a small POC on hosted endpoints but for production we need a Dedicated pool. High level requirements: around 80–120 concurrent QPS for short prompts (median ~40 tokens), peak bursts to 200 QPS, and p95 generation latency target <200ms.

We'd like a walkthrough focused on the Dedicated offering and a quick verification with our sample traffic profile. Can the Redwood team validate that the Dedicated runtime can hit our p95 target and also talk about autoscale/burst behavior? Our CTO (Samir) will want to be on the call.

Proposed window: any day Nov 8–10, mornings PST. If you need pre-demo numbers I can export a 24-hr sample.

Thanks,
Alex Morgan
Head of Platform
DataQuarry
Attachments: none (self-signup metadata submitted)
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@dataquarry.ai>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-11-01T17:21:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Self-signup details + Dedicated capacity ask

Hi Alex — thanks for signing up and for the upfront numbers, this is super helpful.

Quick next steps from our side:
- I'll loop in our SDR/solutions lead (Priyom) to coordinate a short qualifying call and capture the traffic sample you mentioned.
- We'll propose two time slots on Nov 8 that cover PST mornings and include our infra engineer and a runtime PM to run a simple verification during the demo.
- I attached a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) that outlines what we'll cover and what we'll need from DataQuarry ahead of time. Filling the spreadsheet rows helps us pre-configure a test.

Can you confirm Samir is available Nov 8 at 11:00 AM PST or 9:00 AM PST? If neither works, give us a couple alternatives.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Sales (Dedicated)
Redwood Inference
Attachments: DataQuarry_MutualActionPlan_v1.pdf
From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@dataquarry.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-11-02T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Self-signup details + Dedicated capacity ask

Alex — Priyom here, SDR/solutions. Quick clarifying questions so we can size the Dedicated pool for the demo run:
- Are the 80–120 QPS steady-state or bursty (e.g., sustained for >30s)?
- Typical input prompt length (tokens) and output length? You mentioned median ~40 tokens; any 95th percentile length?
- Will you provide a 24-hr sample HTTP log or a synthetic load profile?

We attached a small spreadsheet where you can drop sample metrics (median/95th request size, peak burst duration, concurrency targets). If you can fill that by EOD Nov 5 we can pre-stage a config and run a short 10–15 minute verification on the demo to show p95 numbers.

Also: timezone check — you're on PST, right? Samir's calendar showed him in PST in his profile but wanted to double-check.

Thanks — we'll plan to propose Nov 8 11:00 AM PST as primary and Nov 9 10:00 AM PST as backup.

Attachments: dq_throughput_requirements.xlsx
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@dataquarry.ai>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-11-03T11:34:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Self-signup details + Dedicated capacity ask

Thanks Priyom — quick update: Samir (CTO) will be traveling through Nov 5 and is back Nov 6; he asked to avoid a meeting before the 6th. Nov 8 at 11:00 AM PST works for us.

Answers to your sizing questions (filled from our quick export):
- Steady-state target: 100 QPS, with bursts to 200 QPS that last ~45–90s (we have elastic traffic).
- Median input: 42 tokens; 95th percentile input: 320 tokens (some long-document summarization requests).
- Output median: 60 tokens; output 95th percentile: 480 tokens.

We'll upload a 24-hr sample to the Drive folder (link in my signature) by EOD Nov 5. We'll also include an internal contact for a quick pre-demo verification if you need to kick the tires before the joint call.

—Alex
